name: Market Square
summary: The heart of the town. Even at closing time the air is bread, ale, dung, rust, and people. Here spice is hard currency — and trouble: wealth means you can be gently squeezed by the tax-collector. On the board by the fountain, a crude portrait is nailed up: a wanted notice.
affordances: Set up a stall and sell spice; haggle with buyers
Read the wanted notice (who is that drawn there?)
economy: Spice prices float with your patter and the buyer's standing; flashing wealth draws the taxman.
